title: Lesson 12: Squaring
learningGoals: Square numbers rapidly using multiple patterns.
Extend squaring methods to larger numbers.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Open Squaring with one fast mental-math hook and connect it to prior knowledge.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Recall what you already know about Squaring Numbers Ending in 5.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Explain the rule behind Squaring Numbers Ending in 5 in simple language.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Repeat the rule for Squaring Numbers Near 50 in your own words.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Model Squaring Numbers Near 50 step by step on the board.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Watch the example and say the next step before it is revealed.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Guide the learner through Squaring Numbers Near 50 with prompt-based support.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Solve a scaffolded example on Number Splitting for Squaring.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Shift to independent practice on General Left-to-Right Squaring across difficulty levels.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Answer independent questions on Algebraic Squaring.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Diagnose errors and reteach the exact step that broke down.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Explain the mistake and correct it.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Ask the learner to explain the shortcut before advancing.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Summarize the method for Square Roots of Perfect Squares.
